shay Jones (Assistant Buyer - African, Caribbean and Oriental)
I’m pleased to share that i’ve recently completed The Essential Negotiator course with The Gap Partnership. 

This experience has been a valuable step in strengthening how I approach conversations where outcomes really matter. It reinforced that effective negotiation goes far beyond just reaching an agreement. It’s about creating value, building understanding and delivering sustainable results for all parties involved. 

A few key takeaways that really resonated with me were that it’s important to think about *how* to create value, rather than just focusing on the immediate outcome - looking for ways both parties can walk away feeling positive. I became more aware of how much body language matters, and how small non-verbal cues can shape the tone and direction of a conversation. I also gained more confidence in leaning into difficult conversations, approaching them with structure and clarity instead of avoiding them. 

What I found most impactful was realising how much of a negotiation happen before and around the conversation itself. The most effective negotiations happen through preparation, awareness and intent. 

Looking forward to continuing to apply and build on these skills as I develop professionally. 

#negotiation #personaldevelopment #skillsdevelopment

Olivia Kuevi-Odejimi (Tesco Product Graduate | Law LLB Graduate — Tesco — United Kingdom, United Kingdom)
